ctx.x: Roy Rogers. What’s she talking about, Roy Rogers? See, I used to have a thing for Roy Rogers, because I’m – back – this is back to going to the Dunbar and watching these Western flicks all day long, the serials and things. So in my room, I had a picture of Max Roach and a picture of Roy Rogers, and nobody would say, “What’s the connection

to that?” Same reaction you got. So I say, “Listen. I love Roy Rogers, because I know he’s going to be something good a little later on.” And I like him because he jumps off the horse and jumps in the station wagon. That sounded intelligent to me. I told Max that once. He say, “What?” I say, “Yeah, man, I had a picture of you and a picture of Roy Rogers.” “Roy Rogers? What . . . ?”
